# Web Harbor Solutions

> The Zero-Risk Web Engineering Agency for Local Businesses & Contractors.
> We build your complete, custom high-speed website first. You only pay if you love it.

## Overview & Commercial Model

Web Harbor Solutions replaces the broken, high-risk web agency model. Traditional agencies charge $3,000 to $10,000 upfront for wireframes and empty promises, then bill $150/hr for minor updates on bloated WordPress sites.

Web Harbor Solutions operates on an inverted zero-risk, edge-static engineering model:
- **$0 Upfront Live Spec Demo**: We research and code a complete, mobile-responsive custom specification website first (48-hour initial prototype / 5–7 day full launch turnaround). If the client does not love it, they pay $0 and walk away with zero obligation.
- **$100 One-Time Setup Fee**: Paid only after the client reviews and approves their live custom website on our staging environment.
- **$99/Month All-Inclusive Managed Plan**: Includes Cloudflare global edge hosting, custom domain registration or renewal, SSL encryption, 99.9% uptime SLA, ongoing technical maintenance, security patches, and up to 3 content/design edits per month at $0 extra hourly cost.
- **Month-to-Month Flexibility**: No long-term lock-in contracts. Cancel anytime.
- **Sub-Second Performance**: 95–100 Google PageSpeed scores, sub-second LCP (0.4s) via pure Astro static architecture deployed to 300+ edge locations worldwide. Zero vulnerable WordPress plugins or database exploits.
